The user wants me to identify which colored dot is on the handle of the wrench in the image.

Looking at the wrench in the center of the table, it's a gray tool. It has a head (the open-end part) at the top and a handle extending downward.

Let me look at the dots:
- Yellow dot: at the top, on the head/opening part of the wrench.
- Green dot: at the neck/joint area where the head meets the handle.
- Blue dot: on the lower part, the handle/shaft of the wrench.
- Purple dot: on the orange tool to the right (the screwdriver-like object), not on the wrench.

So the handle of the wrench is the long part. The blue dot is on that handle. The green dot is more at the top near the head. The yellow is at the very top.

Thus the blue dot is on the handle.

The answer is D.
